verdict.rationale: Retell's quick-start promises a first phone agent in about 15 minutes: pick a template or generate one from a prompt, configure the model, voice, and who speaks first, test via a free web call, then assign the agent to a phone number and call it. New accounts get $10 in free credits with no payment method required. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the time to a first live call, and details on buying or provisioning the number (cost, availability).
